en.title: PoppOppTango
en.description:
PoppOppTango ❤️
Welcome to PoppOppTango at Tangoskolen's venue!
Tonight we’ll be dancing in Halli (the medium-sized hall).
Admission: 150 NOK per person.
TDJ: AnniKind (mostly traditional tango, waltz, and milonga, plus some alternative tracks).
We provide tea, coffee, water, fruit, and snacks.
Bring your own drinks, bring a friend, and come join us!
